info.title: refdesk API
info.description: Rights-checked, explained art references from open museum collections. The API enforces approval gates; clients only reflect them (PRD 8B).

post.description:
Start a run from a brief (S1). The search runs after this returns; poll
GET /runs/{run_id}. Retrieval only for now (issue #45): no model is called.

400.description: Declined: unknown anchor or unusable condition

get.description: Run state, gates, items, cost and any stop reason (S2, S3, S7).

post.description:
G3: keep (with a note) or drop each flagged item, recorded with who and when.
Only flagged items can be reviewed; approval (G4) opens when all are decided.

400.description: The board has no such item

post.description:
G1: raise the spend cap — recorded with who and when — and resume from the
checkpoint. Refused (409) for any run the budget cap did not stop. The resume runs
after this returns, the way POST /boards starts the loop; poll GET /runs/{run_id}.

Kill switch (PRD 10.2): the run stops before its next step or model call, and
nothing on it can ever be approved or exported. The run's own thread writes
Cancelled at its next guard check, so poll GET /runs/{run_id} for the final state.
G4: record approval. Blocked (409) until G3 has no undecided items.

G5: export the provenance pack (CSV), then the board is read-only. Irreversible.
Blocked (409) without an approval record.

500.description: Export failed; the board stays unlocked

get.description: The S8 review queue, oldest first.

post.description:
S8: "This is wrong". Queued for human review, with who and when. The board is not
changed.

400.description: The board has no such item

get.description:
Liveness: the process is up. Touches no dependency, so it answers even when
/readyz fails.

Readiness (issue #168): 503 when the metadata store, the embedding index or a
required model backend is unavailable, with the reason per check. The store path is
the metadata store: the runs store shares its SQLite file (default_service).

ApprovalRequest.title: ApprovalRequest
ApprovalRequest.description: G4: rights are as stated by each source; this is not legal advice.

ArtworkRecord.title: ArtworkRecord
ArtworkRecord.description:
One artwork from one source, normalised. Descriptive fields stay None when the
source does not give them; they are never filled in from memory.

flag_reasons.title: Flag Reasons
flag_reasons.description: Why the item needs a human check

score_components.title: Score Components
score_components.description: Named parts of the score that sum to it, e.g. similarity, attributes

opinion_flag.title: Opinion Flag
opinion_flag.description: Set when the judge found the fit sentence may state a fact the record does not give. It does not change attribution_status (ADR-022, issue #135).

keep_local.title: Keep Local
keep_local.description: Never send this brief to a cloud provider

CapRaise.title: CapRaise
CapRaise.description: G1: an explicit, recorded decision to raise the spend cap and resume.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: The board the item is on

reporter.title: Reporter
reporter.description: Who reported it; recorded with the report

ErrorReport.title: ErrorReport
ErrorReport.description: S8: "This is wrong". Queued for human review, then may feed the golden set.

field.title: Field
field.description: Record field that supports the rationale, e.g. 'medium'

ExportRequest.title: ExportRequest
ExportRequest.description: G5: irreversible. Requires an approval record.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who must act, for human gates

ItemReview.title: ItemReview
ItemReview.description: A recorded G3 decision on one flagged item.

LoopState.title: LoopState
LoopState.description: The loop controller's states (PRD 10.2 state diagram).

QueuedReport.title: QueuedReport
QueuedReport.description: A filed S8 report, as it waits in the review queue.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Who decided; recorded with each decision

ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest
ReviewRequest.description: G3: decisions on items in "Needs human check".

RightsRecord.title: RightsRecord
RightsRecord.description: What the source states about rights, and where it says it. Not legal advice.

step.title: Step
step.description: Transition number; a call carries the step it ran in

args_hash.title: Args Hash
args_hash.description: SHA-256 of the arguments, after redaction

model.title: Model
model.description: Model the provider reported, else requested

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: Decision-model adapter hash, when one runs

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: Decision probabilities; none until the router (M4-13)

data.title: Data
data.description: Run parameters (Init) or where a stop fired

recorded.title: Recorded
recorded.description: The tool's output for replay; left out by GET /runs/{id}

RunEvent.title: RunEvent
RunEvent.description:
One line of a run's events.jsonl (PRD 10.2 run log, issue #156). The brief is
redacted before the line is written.

sent_to.title: Sent To
sent_to.description: Providers this brief was sent to

models_used.title: Models Used
models_used.description: Model each role reported, e.g. generator and judge

events.title: Events
events.description: The run log, brief redacted (PRD 10.2); the trace view until Phoenix

StopReason.title: StopReason
StopReason.description:
Why a run ended early (PRD 10.2). The value is the machine code; `banner` is the
StopBanner title.
